148:t_001:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As proof, here I am, standing on the front lines myself to wrap up the operation.」

148:t_001:17.en:
$n
「Don't you go declaring $$新日本$$ finished on your own!」

148:t_001:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't let you! Not as long as we're here!」

148:t_001:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Admirable! Not losing your fighting spirit even though defeat is already decided... You're every inch an Earth person!」

148:t_001:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Deep down, you already know, don't you? That the spirit of this country has broken, and it's finished.」

148:t_001:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's why I'll win...! To keep hope alive!」

148:t_001:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Take down you, the commander, and the whole situation flips! I'll make you regret strolling out here!」

148:t_001:24.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... I was actually planning to press you to surrender at this point, but it did backfire after all.」

148:t_001:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「General $$サルディアス$$! Give the attack order, quickly!」

148:t_001:26.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes, yes, $$ギルター$$. It seems you can hardly wait to avenge your defeat either.」

148:t_001:27.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Fighting out of hatred like that... that's a big yes from me.」

148:t_001:28.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(That composure... it's not mere bluster...)

148:t_001:29.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well then, the moment you've all been waiting for...! Let's begin the attack!」

148:t_001:30.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Today, we put an end to Tokyo and $$新日本$$. Everyone, give it your all!」

148:t_002:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear, you've got me. To think it would turn out like this...」

148:t_002:2.en:
$n
「I'll take you down and settle this!」

148:t_003:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear, you've got me. Holding out this long was not in my calculations.」

148:t_003:2.en:
$n
「I'll take you down and settle this!」

148:t_004:1.en:
$n
「I have to take that guy down here, at least!」

148:t_005:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The unease I've felt all this time... One of the sources is...!」

148:t_006:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even if you can sense me, you can't escape this needle.」

148:t_007:2.en:
$n
「I'm all right...! Not from something like this...!」

148:t_007:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've got some skill... But...」

148:t_007:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Thanks to that, you'll suffer for a long time.」

148:t_008:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Exactly, 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》.」

148:t_008:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now... this time, be swallowed by your own hatred.」

148:t_008:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「While the $$いがみ合う双子$$ thrash in their hatred, let me finish the introductions.」

148:t_008:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My name is $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

148:t_008:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the '$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$'.」

148:t_008:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So you're the Reactor $n ran into!」

148:t_008:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Resentment... In other words, it draws its power from hatred...!」

148:t_008:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I heard you took the $$スフィア$$ from $$ガドライト#pilot$$, so I was looking forward to seeing just how good you are...」

148:t_008:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What a letdown. Just as $$尸空#pilot$$ said, that drunkard is still better than this.」

148:t_008:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You still have your sanity? Tenacity is a trait of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, isn't it.」

148:t_008:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My $$アン・アーレス$$'s venom is working, isn't it? Now you and that ugly machine of yours are finished.」

148:t_008:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Too bad! I can't let you interfere with the boss!」

148:t_009:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We can't go to the rescue like this...!」

148:t_009:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... was it? I'll ask you just once.」

148:t_009:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come to $$サイデリアル$$. That $$スフィア$$ was never yours to begin with.」

148:t_009:5.en:
$n
「No... thanks... Like hell... I'd become... one of the invaders...」

148:t_010:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That attack is coming again!」

148:t_010:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「All the $$スフィア$$s will gather...」

148:t_011:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, concentrate your firepower on $$バルビエル$$!」

148:t_012:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You pests that refuse to die...!」

148:t_014:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh no you don't! I won't let you get anywhere near the Reactor!」

148:t_015:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Tch! So the $$リ・ガズィ$$ is at its limit!」

148:t_015:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$, $$ロックオン$$! Give that to Captain $$アムロ$$!」
